product.description: Iosif Stalin a exercitat puterea supremă in Uniunea Sovietică din 1929 pacirc;nă la moartea sa, in 1953. Pe parcursul acestui sfert de secol, după estimările lui Oleg Hlevniuk, Stalin a ordonat incarcerarea și executarea a nu mai puțin de un milion de cetățeni sovietici pe an. Alte milioane au fost victime ale foametei care a rezultat direct din aplicarea politicilor sale. Ce l-a condus către o asemenea cruzime? Această biografie esențială, scrisă de autorul cel mai familiarizat cu arhivele din era sovietică, oferă un portret fără precedent, in cel mai fin detaliu, al lui Stalin ndash; omul și dictatorul. Fără a-l mitologiza, fie ca pe un geniu binevoitor, fie ca pe un geniu al răului, Hlevniuk răspunde numeroaselor controverse despre anumite evenimente din viața dictatorului, adunacirc;nd sute de scrisori anterior necunoscute, memorii, rapoarte și jurnale, intr-o poveste exhaustivă a vieţii lui Iosif Vissarionovici Djuga șvili, omul care a lăsat cicatrici greu de vindecat asupra popoarelor peste care a domnit și care a schimbat cursul istoriei. Captivantă și zguduitoare, această carte confirmă faptul că Hlevniuk este, probabil, cel mai mare expert in Stalin. O lectură esențială. Simon Sebag Montefiore

# Stalin: A New Biography of a Dictator (Volume 97)

Immerse yourself in one of the most complex and controversial periods of 20th-century history with *Stalin. A New Biography of a Dictator*. This comprehensive volume offers an unparalleled look at the life and reign of Joseph Stalin, examining how he consolidated absolute power within the Soviet Union from 1929 until his death in 1953.

Authored by Oleg Hlevniukâan author renowned for his deep expertise and intimate knowledge of Soviet-era archivesâthis book provides more than just a historical account; it is an exhaustive examination of the man, the regime, and the profound impact he had on global history.

## Understanding Stalinâs Reign in the Soviet Union

The period of Joseph Stalin's rule was marked by immense power and devastating human cost. According to estimates, during this quarter-century, Stalin ordered the incarceration and execution of at least one million Soviet citizens annually. Furthermore, millions more became victims of widespread famine directly resulting from his political policies.

This monumental biography tackles the fundamental question: What led a powerful figure toward such extreme cruelty? The book navigates the darkest chapters of totalitarian rule while presenting a nuanced portrait that avoids both idealization and simple condemnation.

### Why Is This Biography Essential Reading?

Oleg Hlevniuk has dedicated his career to understanding the Soviet era, making him arguably the foremost expert on Stalin's life. *Stalin: A New Biography* distinguishes itself by approaching the subject without mythologizing himâneither as a benevolent genius nor solely as a villain.

The narrative is built upon an incredible wealth of primary sources, including hundreds of previously unknown letters, personal memoirs, official reports, and journals. Hlevniuk methodically addresses numerous historical controversies surrounding Stalin's life, providing readers with an incredibly detailed and authoritative account of Iosif Vissarionovich DjugaÈvili.

This is a captivating and sobering read that sheds light on the enduring scars left by the man who fundamentally changed the course of history for entire nations.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Is this book biased?**

**Who wrote this history?**

**Is this suitable for general readers?**
While covering heavy historical topics, the book is structured as a comprehensive narrative biography designed to educate and captivate general readers interested in 20th-century political history.
